exact_statement: For every n>=3, every Boolean sign F on the uniform n-cube whose nonzero Fourier support has minimum Hamming distance at least3 (singleton distance infinity), every physical vertex v, and G obtained by flipping F(v), put p=2^(-n). For every depth-two physical coordinate-query tree T which queries any coordinate i and then any remaining coordinate j_b depending on the first sign b, with its four actual leaves of weights1/4, let Q=Inf_i(G)+E_b Inf_(j_b)(G_b). Then H(G)-E_T H(G_leaf)<(71/2)p and Q>=4p. Consequently for every real K>=9, E_T[H(G_leaf)-K I(G_leaf)]>H(G)-K I(G)+p/2. Entropy is in bits; no greedy choice, criticality, lower bound on row mass, or renewal of a child influence budget is assumed. This is a paid two-level query theorem, not unrestricted FEI(9).
hypotheses: n>=3; finite uniform cube; Boolean signs
seed Fourier-support minimum Hamming distance>=3; singleton support allowed
exactly one physical vertex flip; arbitrary edit vertex
actual coordinate query, followed by an actual remaining-coordinate query in each sign child
entropy bits; actual leaf probabilities1/4; K>=9 only for deficit consequence
